fato_historico: 2004: Iraq War: More than 10,000 U.S. troops and a small number of Iraqi army units participate in a siege on the insurgent stronghold of Fallujah.

It is a good time to build your foundations with care. Perhaps today is the perfect day to transform your personal challenges into lasting pillars of success.
frase_do_dia: Steady roots grow the tallest trees under the vast and open sky.
significado_numero: The number of infinite abundance and balanced personal authority.
conselho: Consider your long-term goals and step forward with quiet, determined confidence.
